prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-game skill effect material sheet for Kicker, an original cobalt/lime/coral streetwear rooftop kick fighter. This is not a body sheet.
Create 16 SEPARATE effects in strict FOUR columns x FOUR rows, equal cells, transparent margins, no overlap, no text/labels/grid/background. Simple chunky blocky pixel art, hard readable silhouettes, few flat colour shades, no smooth glowing gradients. Colours: electric lime, cobalt, ivory, coral, muted stone grey, dark navy outlines. No human figures.
Row1 cells left to right: (1) small off-white takeoff dust puff with lime flecks, side view; (2) flat oval ground landing dust ring, top down; (3) circular top-down 15000-unit landing shock ring with broken stone chunks and lime graffiti spikes; (4) small grey thrown stone with a short lime trail, travelling right.
Row2: (1) grey rock breaking into compact angular fragments; (2) sharp ivory/coral impact star from a wrapped-foot kick, no foot; (3) lime/ivory curved speed streak trailing toward left; (4) a heavy grey wall-slam impact with stone shards and coral core.
Row3: (1) long sharp downward-right skyfall streak, cobalt/lime/ivory; (2) compact street-graffiti anchor emblem on ground, jade/lime and coral, no letters; (3) snap-return burst of lime and ivory angular streaks around an empty centre; (4) small lime diamond target mark above an invisible target.
Row4: (1) subtle cobalt/lime rooftop footprint outline, flat oval; (2) slim lime/coral Second Wind aura with empty centre for a whole human body; (3) small bruised status medallion, dark coral/purple with a broken ivory contour; (4) faint segmented ivory/lime ground shield ring with empty centre.
Keep distinct effect silhouettes. All ground rings shown as actual top-down rings rather than tall standing wheels. Real transparent background. No black rectangular tiles. Production material sheet, suitable for extraction and conversion to game-size pixel sprites.
